title: Japanese for Taxis in 9 Comic Scenes | Guess, Listen, Say It (Travel Japanese)
lead: Loading your bag, giving the address, directions, stopping and paying, everything for a taxi in Japan in nine comic scenes. Guess first, then listen twice and say it.

intro.title:
Japan taxi
**9 phrases**
intro.say: Nine scenes in a Japanese taxi. Guess each line before the answer.

phrases.label: The trunk
phrases.ja: トランクを開けてもらえますか？
phrases.when: Got a big bag? Ask this before you get in.
phrases.tip: Japanese taxis have rear doors that open and close by themselves. No need to touch them.
phrases.scene: At the curb beside the taxi, Jiwoo stands with a big rolling suitcase and points at the car's trunk; the driver has stepped out on the right and touches his cap politely; Minjun holds a second bag.

phrases.label: Where to
phrases.ja: ここまでお願いします。
phrases.when: When the driver asks where to, show the map and say this.
phrases.tip: Showing the address or a map on your phone is the surest way.
phrases.hear: どちらまでですか？ (Dochira made desu ka?) = Where to?
phrases.short: The one phrase you need in a Japanese taxi
phrases.scene: In the back seat on the left, Jiwoo leans forward and shows her phone with a simple map pin on the screen (no writing); the driver on the right turns his head to look.

phrases.label: How long
phrases.ja: 何分ぐらいかかりますか？
phrases.ko: About how many minutes will it take?
phrases.when: Want to know how long the ride is? Ask this.
phrases.tip: For hours, say nanjikan gurai. Gurai means about.
phrases.scene: In the back seat, Jiwoo taps her wristwatch and leans forward to ask; the driver on the right, hands on the wheel, answers with a calm smile.

phrases.label: I'm in a hurry
phrases.when: Short on time? Tell the driver this.
phrases.tip: Showing the time you need to arrive on your phone helps too.
phrases.scene: In the back seat, Jiwoo clasps her hands together with an anxious, pleading face while Minjun checks his phone; the driver on the right nods.

phrases.label: Giving directions
phrases.ja: 次の信号を右に曲がってください。
phrases.pron: Tsugi no shingou o migi ni magatte kudasai.
phrases.ko: Please turn right at the next light.
phrases.when: Want to give directions yourself? Say this.
phrases.tip: Left is hidari, straight is massugu. Massugu itte kudasai means please go straight.
phrases.scene: From the back seat, Jiwoo points forward and to the right between the front seats; through the windshield a traffic light is ahead; the driver on the right nods.

phrases.label: Stopping here
phrases.ja: ここで止めてください。
phrases.when: When you get where you want to go, say this.
phrases.tip: You can also say koko de ii desu, here is fine.
phrases.short: Get your taxi to stop in Japan
phrases.scene: Jiwoo points out of the left window at a quiet street corner and raises her other hand; the driver on the right slows down with a nod.

phrases.label: Paying by card
phrases.when: Want to pay by card? Ask this.
phrases.tip: Many taxis in Japan now take cards and IC cards. Still, keep a little cash.
phrases.scene: The taxi has stopped; Jiwoo holds up a credit card between the front seats; the driver on the right turns and points at a small card reader near the dashboard.

phrases.label: Receipt
phrases.tip: Ryoushuusho means receipt. Reshiito works too.
phrases.scene: The driver on the right hands back the credit card with a white-gloved hand; Jiwoo holds out her open palm with a polite smile.

bonus.label: Saying goodbye
bonus.ja: ありがとうございました。
bonus.when: Finally, thank the driver like this as you get out.
bonus.scene: Standing on the sidewalk with her suitcase, Jiwoo bows slightly and waves as the rear door closes by itself; Minjun bows too; the driver on the right touches his cap.

outro.title: Recap: **9 phrases**
outro.say: All the phrases are in the description. Tell us in the comments how many you got right. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
